name: App Development
description: Building mobile apps: UI, state, persistence, networking and shipping to the stores.

nodes.name: Mobile platforms
nodes.desc: iOS and Android, native versus cross-platform (Flutter, React Native), and how apps are packaged and run.
nodes.summary: You will be able to compare iOS and Android, native and cross-platform approaches, and explain how mobile apps are packaged and run.
topics: App packages like APK, AAB and IPA

nodes.name: App language
nodes.desc: Getting fluent in the language of your stack: Kotlin, Swift, Dart or TypeScript.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write everyday app code fluently in your stack's language, whether Kotlin, Swift, Dart or TypeScript.

nodes.name: Tooling & emulators
nodes.desc: IDEs, simulators and emulators, debugging, and running on a real device.
nodes.summary: You will be able to set up an IDE, run apps on simulators, emulators and real devices, and debug them effectively.
topics: IDEs like Android Studio, Xcode and VS Code

nodes.name: Mobile UI
nodes.desc: Declarative UI, widgets and components, layout and styling.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build mobile screens with declarative UI components and control their layout and styling.
topics: Declarative UI and rendering from state
Stacks, rows and columns for layout

nodes.name: Lists & layouts
nodes.desc: Scrolling lists, grids, adaptive layouts for phones and tablets.
nodes.summary: You will be able to display scrolling lists and grids efficiently and adapt layouts to different phone and tablet sizes.

nodes.name: Navigation
nodes.desc: Screens, stacks, tabs, passing arguments and deep links.
nodes.summary: You will be able to move between screens using stacks and tabs, pass arguments and open specific screens from deep links.
topics: Stack navigation and the back stack

nodes.name: Theming & a11y
nodes.desc: Design systems, dark mode, dynamic type and screen readers.
nodes.summary: You will be able to apply a consistent design system with dark mode and make apps usable with dynamic type and screen readers.
topics: Screen reader labels with VoiceOver and TalkBack
Touch target size and colour contrast

nodes.name: Todo app
nodes.desc: Build a multi-screen todo app with lists, navigation and a polished theme.
nodes.summary: You will build a multi-screen todo app with lists, navigation between screens and a polished, consistent theme.
topics: Designing todo list and detail screens
Applying a theme and dark mode

nodes.name: App state
nodes.desc: Local versus shared state, state hoisting, view models and unidirectional data flow.
nodes.summary: You will be able to decide where state should live and manage it with view models and unidirectional data flow.

nodes.name: App lifecycle
nodes.desc: Foreground, background and process death; saving and restoring state.
nodes.summary: You will be able to handle foreground, background and process death so your app saves and restores state reliably.

nodes.name: Local storage
nodes.desc: Key-value preferences, files and on-device SQL databases (SQLite, Room, Core Data).
nodes.summary: You will be able to store data on the device with key-value preferences, files and SQL databases such as SQLite, Room or Core Data.

nodes.name: Async & threads
nodes.desc: Keeping the main thread free: coroutines, async/await and background work.
nodes.summary: You will be able to keep the main thread responsive by moving slow work to background threads with coroutines or async/await.
topics: The main UI thread and freezes
Updating UI safely from background work

nodes.name: Notes app
nodes.desc: Build a notes app with search and on-device persistence that survives restarts.
nodes.summary: You will build a notes app with search and on-device persistence so notes survive app restarts.
topics: Note data model and database schema

nodes.name: Networking
nodes.desc: Calling REST APIs, JSON parsing, error handling and loading states.
nodes.summary: You will be able to call REST APIs from an app, parse JSON responses and show loading, success and error states.
topics: Loading, success and error UI states

nodes.name: Sign-in & security
nodes.desc: Login flows, secure token storage and OAuth on mobile.
nodes.summary: You will be able to implement sign-in flows on mobile, store tokens securely and use OAuth with PKCE.
topics: Secure storage with Keychain and Keystore

nodes.name: Offline & sync
nodes.desc: Caching responses, offline-first design, and syncing local data with a server.
nodes.summary: You will be able to design offline-first apps that cache responses and synchronise local changes with a server.

nodes.name: Weather app
nodes.desc: Build a weather app that fetches forecasts from a public API, caches them for offline use, and handles errors gracefully.
nodes.summary: You will build a weather app that fetches forecasts from a public API, caches them offline and handles errors gracefully.

nodes.name: Device features
nodes.desc: Permissions, camera, location and sensors.
nodes.summary: You will be able to request permissions and use the camera, location and motion sensors in a mobile app.

nodes.name: Notifications
nodes.desc: Local and push notifications and background tasks.
nodes.summary: You will be able to schedule local notifications, receive push notifications and run tasks in the background.

nodes.name: Testing & perf
nodes.desc: Unit and UI tests, profiling, startup time and smooth scrolling.
nodes.summary: You will be able to test apps with unit and UI tests and profile startup time, memory and scrolling performance.
topics: Unit tests for logic and view models

nodes.name: Publishing
nodes.desc: Signing, store listings, review guidelines, releases and crash reporting.
nodes.summary: You will be able to sign, release and monitor an app on the App Store or Play Store, including crash reporting.

nodes.name: Capstone app
nodes.desc: Design, build and publish (to a test track) an app with sign-in, a backend API, offline support and notifications.
nodes.summary: You will design, build and publish to a test track an app with sign-in, a backend API, offline support and notifications.
